items.title: Viral AI assistant Instinct now has its own email address
items.summary: Instinct’s new email feature lets the AI agent create and manage accounts, contact businesses, handle support requests, and do more on users' behalf.

items.title: Uber rival inDrive scales beyond ride-hailing to capture more consumer spending
items.summary: inDrive's ad business, first piloted in July 2025, has served more than 2 billion impressions and attracted over 2,000 paying advertisers a month.

items.title: ‘Gambling with our lives’: Anthropic researcher quits, warns against self-improving AI
items.summary: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned over AI extinction fears, calling for pacing agreements between labs.

items.title: Shipt becomes the latest delivery app with an AI shopping assistant
items.summary: Users can ask the assistant to do things like "Create a cart for my Saturday tailgate for 25 people and include some brunch items," or "Build a cart for easy school lunches and after-school snacks," Shipt says.

items.title: Uber invests $10M in Indian fleet operator Carrum at $168M valuation
items.summary: Carrum Mobility operates about 5,100 vehicles in India and is Uber's largest fleet partner for its premium Uber Black service in the country.

items.title: AI spend per employee slumped at top firms in August — summer doldrums or a warning sign?
items.summary: Falling token costs, cheaper models, and less spend per employee—AI adoption isn't playing out the way hyperscalers hoped.

items.title: Group of bipartisan lawmakers ask US government to ban several hack-for-hire firms
items.summary: The three Indian companies are accused of using hackers to steal information used to sway litigation.

items.title: Instacart launches an AI grocery shopping assistant called Clementine
items.summary: Instacart is the latest app to bake a conversational AI assistant into its platform.

items.title: Autonomy pivots to gas vehicles to keep the dream of car subscriptions alive
items.summary: Scott Painter, founder of TrueCar, is still trying to build a business around vehicle subscriptions, where you can cancel at any time.

items.title: Sequoia doubles down on Cymphony as AI agents create new enterprise security risks
items.summary: Cymphony was valued at more than $100 million in a $25 million Series A co-led by Sequoia and SMBC Fin Atlas Beyond Fund.

items.title: Besxar is building an orbital semiconductor factory, one SpaceX rocket at a time
items.summary: If you want to manufacture in space—and bring the products back again—there’s a limited set of options: Wait to go to the International Space Station, or partner with a handful of start-ups launching spacecraft that spend time in orbit before they return to Earth. items.title: Suno replaces its AI models with a new one trained on licensed music as copyright suits pile up
items.summary: As it grapples with a bevy of lawsuits, Suno said its new model, Suno v6, is not trained using music it used to train previous versions of the AI model.

items.title: Google DeepMind alumni are building tools to accelerate fusion power for the grid
items.summary: Fusionality is developing control systems and simulation environments to help fusion power startups move faster.

items.title: CloudNC raises $20M to automate manufacturing’s most pressing bottlenecks
items.summary: UK-based manufacturing software startup CloudNC announced Wednesday a $20 million B extension round, bringing its lifetime total raised amount to $128 million.

items.title: White House takes down ‘Build the Wall’ game after the Tetris Company complains
items.summary: The Trump administration's short-lived arcade game "Build the Wall" is now nowhere to be found after the Tetris Company posted that it takes "copyright infringement very seriously."

items.title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
items.summary: Last month, a Claude user noticed his account was consuming tokens even though he wasn't working. Anthropic has since warned users about hackers.

items.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
items.summary: Cognition's valuation multiple is higher than Cursor's was before selling to SpaceX.

items.title: The Exploration Company nabs $450 million to challenge SpaceX
items.summary: The Exploration Company (TEC) has raised $450 million to build reusable spacecraft, in what it describes as “the largest-ever Series C by a European space company.”

items.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
items.summary: Meta's new personal AI agent Muse wants access to users' email, calendars, payments, health services, and more — making the company's biggest consumer AI bet yet a major test of whether people still trust Meta with their data.

items.title: How to watch Apple’s foldable iPhone announcement
items.summary: Apple's annual iPhone event will stream live on September 9 at 10 a.m. PDT, and we're expecting big news.
